scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/docling/ui && npm run build -w apps/obsidian/ui && npm run build -w apps/zotero/ui && npm run build -w apps/obsidian/api && npm run build -w packages/mcp-common && npm run build -w apps/obsidian/mcp && npm run build -w apps/zotero/mcp
scripts.format: biome check --write apps packages scripts tests icons.lock.json
scripts.lint: biome check apps packages scripts tests icons.lock.json && python3 -m compileall -q apps/docling/controller
scripts.test: npm run check:controller && node --test tests/package-contract.test.mjs apps/obsidian/sync/livesync-lifecycle.test.mjs apps/obsidian/sync/livesync-setup.test.mjs apps/obsidian/livesync-worker/worker-state.test.mjs apps/zotero/automations/test_worker.mjs apps/zotero/package/variants.test.mjs && npm run build -w packages/mcp-common && npm run test -w apps/obsidian/api && npm run test -w apps/obsidian/mcp && npm run test -w apps/zotero/mcp && PYTHONWARNINGS=error::ResourceWarning python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/docling/controller -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check:controller: node --check apps/obsidian/sync/controller.mjs && node --check apps/obsidian/sync/livesync-setup.mjs && node --check apps/obsidian/sync/livesync-settings.mjs && node --check apps/obsidian/sync/livesync-lifecycle.mjs && node --check apps/obsidian/livesync-worker/worker.mjs && node --check apps/obsidian/livesync-worker/worker-state.mjs && node --check apps/zotero/controller/controller.mjs
